items.title: Pro Dota 2 Player Claims He Had to Play a Full Match in Front of Police Officers to Prove His Identity
items.excerpt: A pro Dota 2 player is claiming he had to play a full Dota match in front of police officers to prove his identity. Thankfully, he had the sauce.
items.content_text: A pro Dota 2 player is claiming that he had to play a full Dota match in front of police officers to prove his identity. According to Nuengnara "23savage" Teeramahanon, who currently plays hard carry for Xipto eSports, the team’s boot camp in Kuala Lumpur was raided by police Sunday evening. In a post made on Facebook Monday night, 23savage describes the police placing the team in handcuffs and confiscating their belongings. The officers proceeded to interrogate the players about why they were in the city and whether they were really pro players. According to 23savage, one of the officers was familiar with Dota, and was willing to scroll the player’s Instagram for proof of his pro career. ​23savage’s bootcamp got raided by Malaysia police by u/Phenylalanin3 in DotA2 A photo 23savage had recently posted of himself and popular Malaysian influencer Ms. Puiyi was, according to the post, somewhat acceptable evidence. Enough evidence, in fact, for the police officers to remove his handcuffs and test what really mattered: how good he is at defending the ancients. 23savage proceeded to start up a Dota match right in front of the police officers, dropping 23 kills as the hard carry Kez. The Dota player alleges that this was enough proof to convince the officers to let the team go, and also that they stole two jars of Nutella on their way out. Commenters on the post quickly doubted 23savage’s claims, presuming the post to be a joke, but 23savage has been actively defending his story in the replies. Reddit users continue to doubt the hard carry player, while others jokingly claim 23savage’s story is saving Valve’s MOBA. The incident doesn’t seem to have had much impact on Xipto, who have been climbing the ranks of SEA Dota. The team recently won the EPL SEA tournament without losing a single series, achieving an impressive 10-match win streak. The team’s full roster currently consists of 23savage (Carry), inYourdreaM (Mid), Fbz (Offlane), Q (Support), and Oli (Support), who are now competing for a spot in the DreamLeague Season 30 tournament . Dota 2 itself has been seeing some notable player gains in 2026, having recently hit its peak player count since 2022 . The game continues to receive occasional patches and content updates, though Valve's focus is largely now on a new MOBA: Deadlock .

items.title: Mortal Kombat Creator Ed Boon Responds to Street Fighter Cast Saying They Want a Crossover Movie
items.excerpt: Mortal Kombat co-creator Ed Boon has responded after the cast of the Street Fighter movie were vocally enthusiastic about the idea of a crossover film with Mortal Kombat, and it looks like he’s open to the possibility, too — as long as a game gets made first.
items.content_text: Mortal Kombat co-creator Ed Boon has responded after the cast of the Street Fighter movie were vocally enthusiastic about the idea of making a crossover film with Mortal Kombat, and it looks like he’s open to the possibility, too — as long as a game gets made first. I got the chance to chat with the cast of the Street Fighter movie ahead of its October 16 release, and many of the actors involved told me they’re absolutely game for a crossover with the Mortal Kombat films. In fact, Andrew Schulz joked that this was the real goal of his infamous jab at the MK cast during the 2025 Game Awards. “Hell yeah,” Andrew Koji, who plays Ryu, told me when asked about the possibility. “That’d be sick.” (He even brought up the idea of a Marvel vs Capcom movie, though that particular project is extremely unlikely to ever happen.) “I want more Street Fighter,” Noah Centineo, who plays Ken, added. “If you bring an opportunity to us to be able to come back and reup these incredible characters, I’m down, and I know we’re all down. So if that’s Mortal Kombat, if that’s me kicking Thor in his face, you know?” It wasn’t long before Ed Boon himself became aware of these comments, which he responded to in a post on Twitter/X. “Game first... then movie,” he wrote alongside a winky face emoticon. While Boon is probably just trolling, this isn’t the first time he’s mentioned the idea of Street Fighter and Mortal Kombat colliding; in May 2026, he tweeted about wanting a Street Fighter guest character in a Mortal Kombat game, saying he was a “huge fan” of the series. Game first... then movie. ;) — Ed Boon (@noobde) October 15, 2026 Given that Mortal Kombat is a fighting game franchise known for its wild and wacky crossovers, a Street Fighter collab certainly wouldn’t be a stretch for the folks at Netherrealm. Street Fighter has had its own share of crossover games over the years ( Street Fighter x Tekken , Project X Zone , Tatsunoko vs Capcom , to name a few), but the brutality and bloodiness of Mortal Kombat seems at odds with Street Fighter’s branding… and that’s exactly why Capcom rejected a proposal from Netherrealm when they were approached for a partnership some time ago. “It's true that a proposal for a Street Fighter character in Mortal Kombat was rejected by Capcom,” former Street Fighter producer Yoshiniori Ono said in a 2019 interview . “But it wasn't me personally! There were many people at the company that felt that it wasn't a good fit for our characters. I actually met Ed [Boon] at the Brazil game show and spoke to him personally about it. So it's true — but I didn't make the decision!” Now that Street Fighter is under new leadership that seems keen on crossovers and guest characters of all types , it’s possible that Capcom’s tune may have changed. They were enthusiastic about Yujiro Hanma joining Tekken 8 , for example, and even seemed open to the idea of collaborating with Baki again , which previously enjoyed a partnership with Street Fighter 6 in 2023 and 2024. It’s also worth noting that, now that Paramount and Warner Bros have merged , Skydance owns the rights to the Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter films — so at least as far as red tape is concerned, there are far less obstacles standing in the way of these two worlds colliding on the big screen.

items.title: RuneScape Reignited Canceled Less Than Two Weeks After Being Announced
items.excerpt: Creative director Mod Ryan announced that RuneScape Reignited, a new game mode designed for both old and seasoned players to start fresh, has been canceled less than two weeks after it was first announced.
items.content_text: Creative director Mod Ryan announced that RuneScape Reignited, a new game mode designed for both old and seasoned players to start fresh, has been canceled less than two weeks after it was first announced. The news was published on October 15 in the form of an official YouTube video and blog post, where Mod Ryan revealed that Jagex’s choice to cancel Reignited was in direct response to player feedback. “We received a ton of different perspectives from all of you, and we truly appreciate everyone sharing their views. It is super important to us because the last time we didn't listen to player feedback, combat changed forever. And it has taken us over a decade to recover from that. Now I said on stage that we would not repeat the same mistakes of the past, and I truly stand by that. Considering this, we have made the decision to cancel Reignited,” the post reads. “It is clear that we missed the mark on this, and so we are not moving forward with it. Our goal is to see RuneScape grow again, with returning players coming back and new players joining, but never at the expense of our existing community.” That being said, that doesn’t mean RuneScape is now without any exciting developments for new players who are looking to finally try it out for themselves; starting December 2, RuneScape will hold a 10-day free trial that will let new characters — or any character that, by that date, hasn’t been in membership since June 2 — access RuneScape Members worlds and content until December 12. The team at Jagex are also releasing the Adventure Guide and the first part of the Remastered Journey, as well as a “host of other improvements” to the game. Its 2027 roadmap is still going strong, and Plugins are still scheduled to launch on Monday, October 19. “There's tons of combat and skilling content throughout. We're bringing decade-old storylines to a close, with a return to a proper grandmaster quest. And we're reworking a core skill that is fundamental to the player experience: Agility. All of this while still continuing to deliver meaningful changes as part of the Road to Restoration,” Ryan said. “...the future of RuneScape is still extremely bright. RuneScape will always be built for and defined by its community. So please keep letting us know when you feel we're getting it wrong and shout with that same energy when you think we're getting it right too,” he continued. RuneCcape Reignited was revealed on October 3 during RuneFest 2026 . Essentially, it’s like WoW Forever , allowing both new and returning players to start off with a clean slate and experience the game as if everyone were playing it for the first time. However, a vocal portion of the game’s playerbase felt that this would fracture its community, arguing that it would be better for the devs to focus on ongoing updates and improvements, instead — and it seems like Jagex listened to their concerns. It looks like players are extremely happy about this turn of events, if the top posts on the game's subreddit are anything to go by. "I’m glad to see Reignited is canceled, that does go a long way to rebuilding trust," one player wrote. "...We’re here because we love this game and we do want more people to join, because it’s no secret that our playerbase is small and does not grow much. We want new people, but we want them to join this game, not a parallel copy of this game." "We said no to Hero Pass and they removed it, we said no to Reignited and they removed it, we b**ched and moaned about [microtransactions] they eventually removed [them]. This is the reason the game is almost three decades old with active players," another said. RuneScape 4 was also announced at RuneFest. While we don’t know much about it yet, we do know that it’s designed to be a next-gen version of the celebrated MMO built on the Unreal Engine. No release date has yet been shared.
items.title_en: RuneScape Reignited Canceled Less Than Two Weeks After Being Announced

items.title: Dell Just Released Its New 32" Alienware AW3226Q 4K Gaming Monitor With RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Tech
items.excerpt: Now available for a surprisingly competitive price.
items.content_text: Dell just released a gaming monitor featuring one of the newest panel technologies at a surprisingly affordable price. The new-for-2026 32" Alienware AW3226Q gaming monitor is now available at Dell.com at a launch price of $699.99 with free shipping. This is a rare gaming monitor that combines a native 4K resolution with a gorgeous OLED panel, now made better with LG's new RGB Stripe Tandem OLED technology. If you're looking for an excellent 4K gaming monitor that you plan to also use as your daily workhorse, then the AW3226Q should be on your short list. New Release: 32" Alienware AW3226Q 4K OLED Monitor The Alienware AW3226Q has no lack of features that make it stand out from the crowd, but perhaps its most impressive technology is the RGB stripe tandem OLED panel. Tandem OLED stacks multiple OLED layers on top of each other instead of a single layer. Tandem OLED is better than other OLED panels because: 1) it's much brighter (the AW3226Q in particular has impressive 1,000 nits of peak brightness) and 2) it's less prone to burn-in. The AW3226Q doubles down on this with new RGB stripe technology. Whereas traditional tandem OLEDs use white pixels, RGB stripe tandem OLED breaks the color down further into vertically aligned red, green, and blue pixels. This reduces color fringing and in turn significantly improves text clarity. It goes without saying that there are obvious benefits here for both gaming and productivity purposes alike. With an impressive 3840 x 2160 (4K) resolution, this 32" monitor boasts a pixel density of 138ppi. OLED monitors are known for their extreme fast response time and perfect black levels, making them ideal for gaming. The AW3926QW ups the ante with its 165Hz refresh rate at 4K and support for AMD FreeSync Premium Pro and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility. It has both DisplayPort 2.1 and HDMI 2.1 ports so you'll be able to connect it to just about any modern day graphics card. Alienware also backs the monitor up with a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in. items.title: Tactical PC FPS Game Squad Is Coming to Consoles, Playable PS5 Alpha Releases Later This Month
items.excerpt: The acclaimed PC shooter, Squad, is coming to consoles and PS5 players will be able to experience it very soon.
items.content_text: The acclaimed PC shooter, Squad , is coming to consoles — and PS5 players will be able to experience it very soon. Developer Offworld Industries has announced that Squad will be making its way to Xbox Series X|S and PS5. PlayStation players will be able to give it a whirl later this month with a playable alpha, which will take place from October 16 - 25. Xbox players will have to wait for the full release, unless Offworld provides another opportunity to test the console version out ahead of launch. The developer has promised an optimised experience for console with handpicked maps, a "bespoke polish for flawless performance," optional crossplay with other consoles, and new communication methods via a radial wheel that allows you to issue commands and pings. The game is expected to bring its 50v50 matches to the consoles, as well. If you're interested in checking out the alpha on PS5, you can click here to sign up . As of right now, there's no release date for Squad's console version. The PC version of the game launched in 2020, and it has been one of the more beloved tactical shooters on Steam for some time. Before Wardogs ever came into the picture, Squad attempted to strike a balance between the milsim nature of Arma with the more fast-paced action of more mainstream shooters like Call of Duty or Battlefield. It'll be interesting to see if Squad can beat Wardogs to consoles. Bulkhead has already announced that Wardogs will hit consoles in 2028 and recently told IGN that expects the game to also have a port on next-gen hardware, when it becomes available. The studio also revealed that it has been building Wardogs with Xbox Series S in mind, ensuring that not only will it be optimized for consoles, but also for lower-end PCs.

items.title: The Mummy 4 Now Officially Titled The Mummy: Book of the Dead
items.excerpt: The Mummy: Book of the Dead is the official title of the next movie in Brendan Fraser’s beloved action-adventure film franchise.
items.content_text: The Mummy: Book of the Dead is the official title of the next movie in Brendan Fraser’s beloved action-adventure film franchise. Universal Pictures confirmed the news on Thursday, October 15, exactly one year out from its release date on October 15, 2027. While this date had already been revealed, Universal stated that it remains the same, with the film still on track to hit theaters this time next year. Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz are set to return as Rick and Evie O’Connell, alongside other cast members including John Hannah, Michael Johnston, Numan Acar, Kevin J. O’Connor and Oded Fehr. We’ve already seen some of these characters back in action; Fehr shared a look at himself as Ardeth Bay on Instagram back in August, while recent photos taken from set showed Faser and Weisz in full costume reprising their adventures together. First set pics of The Mummy 4 with Rachel Weisz's Evelyn O’Connell by u/TheBigGAlways369 in UniversalMonsters The Mummy: Book of the Dead is being directed by Radio Silence’s Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett will direct the film, with David Coggeshall (The Family Plan, Orphan: First Kill) writing the screenplay. Mummy fans will be happy to hear that Sean Daneil is producing, given his long history with the franchise, having produced every single film in the series. The new movie’s title certainly leaves ample room for speculation as to what its plot will be. Combined with Oded Fehr’s return as Ardeth Bay, it’s looking more likely than ever that Imhotep is back and wreaking havoc once more, bringing the series back to its roots. For those who need a bit of a refresher on Mummy lore, the Book of the Dead is an ancient tome that contains spells capable of bringing the dead back to life and summoning the Warriors of the Book. It appeared in the very first Mummy movie and was last seen in The Scorpion King 3: Battle for Redemption. Fehr’s involvement in this movie is also a big hint that things are returning to form; he was notably absent from 2008’s The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor, saying that without Imhotep as the big baddie, his character wouldn’t have any reason to appear. Given that the Book of the Dead is almost certainly involved in this movie, and Ardeth Bay is back in action, it’s possible that someone summons Imhotep back into the land of the living using the Book, bringing the gang back together again. For now, nothing is certain. Most recently, Fehr joked that the third Mummy movie didn’t exist , saying at Comic-Con Holland: “It’s a very positive thing. The Mummy, The Mummy Returns — there wasn’t a third one — but the two movies were so… seriously, it was just fun.” The Mummy: Book of the Dead hits theaters on October 15, 2027.

items.title: Sacrifice Review
items.excerpt: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy lead this semi-satirical and surprisingly melancholy Netflix movie.
items.content_text: Sacrifice hits Netflix on October 16. Isn’t it nice when Netflix puts out a decent movie? Yes, the streaming juggernaut releases high quality efforts from auteurs like Scorsese and Del Toro , but then there’s the neverending parade of star-driven , empty calorie mediocrity; mostly paper thin comedy-action films with forgettable plots and vapid characters, whose only strengths come from the charisma of the actors playing them. At this point, Chris Evans is one of many likable actors who has made a few of these types of movies now, for multiple streamers, so it’s easy to assume Sacrifice will be another example. Yet lo and behold, this one actually feels like something with more commendable aspirations. More New Movie Reviews You Can See Everything Review Whalefall Review Ray Gunn Review Wildwood Review Street Fighter Review Sense and Sensibility Review Evans plays movie star Mike Tyler here, attending a climate charity event on a Greek island while attempting a comeback after a public meltdown a year earlier. However, the event is interrupted by a cult-like group of radicals, led by Joan (Anya Taylor-Joy), who take everyone hostage at gunpoint. And then… things actually go quite differently than you’d expect from a Netflix movie with this set-up and these stars. Because it’s incredibly easy to imagine the version of Sacrifice where Evans’ Mike must rise to the occasion, putting his movie star training into real world use… for halfhearted comedy-action hijinks. But director and co-screenwriter Romain Gavras and his co-screenwriter, Will Arbery, have something more cerebral in mind. So while there are comedic moments to the film, especially early on, the story is actually focused on Mike as a man adrift – well aware of the performative nature of the rich, famous and powerful people he’s among – and what happens when he comes face to face with a group of genuine, albeit most certainly violent, activists. While there are comedic moments to the film, especially early on, the story is actually focused on Evans' Mike as a man adrift. Mike is one of three partygoers, along with billionaire Ben (Vincent Cassel) and performer Katie (Ambika Mod), to be chosen by Joan and her group for a supposed sacrifice in order to stop what they believe to be the imminent end of the world in just two days. This combination of a doomsday-prophet-on-a-mission story with an eat the rich hostage scenario ultimately feels somewhat like an enticing combination of this year’s Sam Rockwell-led Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die and another Anya Taylor-Joy movie, The Menu . The journey that follows takes a lot of notable turns, as Mike begins to be drawn to the self-assured Joan and her absolute certainty in herself and what her mission is. And again, thankfully, Mike’s privileged movie star background isn’t used for just the jokey “get a load of this blowhard” approach it could be, but rather for something more introspective and thoughtful… …Well, mostly. Because there are still some mannered, would-be pop-culture-skewing moments included, mostly via cutaways to some of the media attention the hostage story is getting or through Mike’s agent, Oliver (Sam Richardson). But as the story continues, these “wackier” scenes feel increasingly like a distracting, disconnected element that exists outside the central story. Produced independently – Netflix picked it up following film festival screenings – Sacrifice has a strong visual approach thanks to music video veteran Gavras and cinematographer Matias Boucard. There are some great shots of the film’s island setting, nearby volcano included, and Gavras is among the directors who has realized that Taylor-Joy’s unique features, shot in a stark closeup (including straight to camera), make for a stirring cinematic image in their own right, particularly when the actress is playing a determined character such as Joan. Sacrifice doesn’t quite accomplish all it’s setting out to do, and despite strong work from Evans and Taylor-Joy, the characters are more archetypes than richly detailed. But they work well for what they are and in their depiction of two very different people on this odd and unexpected journey together. Those out of place, heightened comedy segments aside, the film is actually quite strange and melancholy in an inviting way, backed by an atmospheric score by Gener8ion and cool song choices like Leonard Cohen’s “Who By Fire” (meanwhile, Charli xcx pops up early on at the charity event, singing a tongue in cheek song about helping the environment). Cassel has some strong moments as the arrogant Ben, while Yung Lean and Jade Croot both convey the right attitude as Joan’s likeminded siblings and partners. John Malkovich is a great casting get as Joan’s father (Malkovich and Taylor-Joy as father and daughter just seems right), though he feels underutilized. Salma Hayek Pinault has some fun moments early on as Ben’s wife, though the character feels somewhat forgotten about as the film progresses.
items.title_en: Sacrifice Review

items.title: Activision Confirms Brand New Call of Duty Subfranchise Is in the Works, Leading to Rampant Fan Speculation
items.excerpt: Activision is actively developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise, suggesting it is ready to move on from Black Ops and Modern Warfare for the time being.
items.content_text: Activision is actively developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise, suggesting it is ready to move on from Black Ops and Modern Warfare for the time being. In a new interview with The Game Business , Activision's Chief Marketing Officer, Tyler Bahl, confirmed that one of its studios is developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise. Although Bahl didn't state which studio is making it or when it would release, it is widely believed this will be the next game from Sledgehammer Games, expected to release next year. He also noted that Modern Warfare 4 will conclude the story that Infinity Ward has been telling since 2019, but suggested that universe could continue in the future with certain characters. However, Activision believes the path forward for Call of Duty is less about leaning on legacy franchises and familiar faces, and more about innovation. “Where we go with future games, we have to innovate," said Bahl. "What we heard from the audience is they want new or better or different. The landscape is changing right under our feet. You’re seeing new games being built overnight, and you’re seeing tastes change and how people want to play.” These comments have led to all kinds of speculation about where the next Call of Duty game will go. Will they try to go into the future? The far-flung past? What kind of mechanic can they introduce to make it feel fresh without changing things up too much? Well, a rumor from Call of Duty leaker TheGhostofHope in 2025 may provide some insight, assuming it pans out. The rumor suggests that Sledgehammer's next game will have a focus on martial arts, with karate kicks and karate chops. It's possible that Sledgehammer is trying to lean into John Wick's gun-fu combat, which mixes satisfying gunplay with fluid, flashy close-quarters combat. That seems more doable for a third-person game with a heavy emphasis on animations, but a first-person, fast-paced, competitive game may have a harder time implementing that kind of gameplay. If it works out, it could be really compelling, though. Interestingly enough, Sledgehammer Games really began its tenure as a Call of Duty team by trying to innovate. The studio was built with the expectation that it would develop a third-person Call of Duty game set in the Vietnam War, attempting to leverage the team's experience on games like Dead Space to create a new kind of Call of Duty experience. That project was eventually killed as Sledgehammer was pulled in to help develop the original Modern Warfare 3 after Infinity Ward imploded. Still, Sledgehammer tried to innovate again with its first solo title, Advanced Warfare. The game introduced exosuits, allowing players to jump, dash, and slide thanks to enhanced movement mechanics. It was a radical leap for Call of Duty, though fans largely rejected attempts to take the franchise into the future. Since then, Sledgehammer has played it fairly safe with two World War 2 games and a different game that also happened to be titled Modern Warfare 3, ironically enough. Whether Sledgehammer Games can make something to excite fans again remains to be seen, but it'll be nice to have a non-MW or Black Ops game for the first time in more than five years.
items.title_en: Activision Confirms Brand New Call of Duty Subfranchise Is in the Works, Leading to Rampant Fan Speculation

items.title: Sony Explores Unconventional Release and Box Office Strategy for Beatles Biopics
items.excerpt: ony Pictures is mulling a few different novel release strategies for director Sam Mendes’ The Beatles — A Four-Film Cinematic Event, from releasing all four films on the same day in April 2028 to lumping the box office returns of all four films together so that no one Beatle biopic can be deemed more successful than the other.
items.content_text: Sony Pictures is mulling a few different novel release strategies for director Sam Mendes’ The Beatles — A Four-Film Cinematic Event , from releasing all four films on the same day in April 2028 to lumping the box office returns of all four films together so that no one Beatle biopic can be deemed more successful than the other. According to sources for The Hollywood Reporter , the studio and Mendes “have long mulled dropping all four movies the same day. In addition, Mendes and the studio have been pondering a highly unique reporting structure for the films’ box office receipts. Instead of releasing each film’s tally individually, the studio has been considering lumping the returns of all four movies together.” Sony may also offer filmgoers a four-pack of tickets to the entire quartet of films, but that would require theater chains to figure out how exactly to sell that to filmgoers. THR adds: “Assuming all four movies do indeed drop the same week, sources also say the plan is to market the films as not having a particular order — that there will be no ‘right’ order in which to watch the films.” What Sony hopes to avoid is a scenario where audiences are seen to prefer any one member of the Fab Four over the other, where maybe most filmgoers go to see the John Lennon or Paul McCartney movie and wait for streaming to watch the George Harrison or Ringo Starr ones. Pippa Harris, one of the films’ producers, recently spoke at the BFI London Film Festival ’s Industry Forum where she said the filmmakers and studio “want people to be able to experience them in the cinema at the same time, during the same period. … Now that doesn’t necessarily mean we’re thinking that people will go and see all four films on the same day. But within the same month, you might see one a week, or you might see one film one weekend and another the next.” The cast includes Harris Dickinson as John Lennon, Paul Mescal as Paul McCartney, Joseph Quinn as George Harrison, and Barry Keoghan as Ringo Starr . Saoirse Ronan plays Linda McCartney, Anna Sawai plays Yoko Ono, Aimee Lou Wood plays Pattie Boyd, Mia McKenna-Bruce plays Maureen Starkey, David Morrissey plays Paul McCartney’s father Jim McCartney, Leanne Best plays John Lennon’s Aunt Mimi, James Norton plays their manager Brian Epstein, Harry Lloyd plays music producer George Martin, Bobby Schofield plays road manager and confidant Neil Aspinall, Daniel Hoffman-Gill plays roadie Mal Evans, Arthur Darvill plays press officer Derek Taylor, and Adam Pally plays music manager Allen Klein.

items.title: Sony Just Announced a $6,000 Gold-Plated Walkman
items.excerpt: Have you ever looked at your phone and thought, "This should only play music, and it should be shinier?" Well, good news, Sony is bringing out a $5,899 Walkman, and it's gold plated.
items.content_text: Have you ever looked at your phone and thought, "This should only play music, and it should be shinier?" Well, good news, Sony is bringing out a $5,899 Walkman, and it's gold plated. The NW-WM1ZM3 model will be available in January, but preorders are available now. According to Sony, the gold isn't just there for show. According to the official announcement: "The NW-WM1ZM3 is built around a precision-machined, gold-plated oxygen-free copper (OFC) chassis, engineered specifically to further elevate the sound quality of this flagship model. It features a 99.99% (4N) purity OFC main chassis and an OFC rear chassis. These are secured with screws featuring a low-resistance gold-plated treatment applied exclusively for this model, providing a stable ground connection that delivers powerful bass, an expansive soundstage, and smooth, extended high frequencies." It also has 35 hours of battery life, a 5.5-inch screen, and uses Sony's DSD Remastering Engine for better sound quality. This isn't Sony's first gold-plated Walkman; it released the NW-WM1ZM2 for $3,200 back in 2022. Those now go for around $1,500 on eBay, if you're looking for a bargain.

items.title: Obsession’s Nikki, Buddy the Unicorn Top This Year’s Most-Googled Halloween Costumes
items.excerpt: Google has released its top 10 most-searched Halloween costumes, and unsurprisingly, Nikki Freeman from Obsession and Buddy the Unicorn are two of the most popular searches this year.
items.content_text: Google has released its top 10 most-searched Halloween costumes, and unsurprisingly, Nikki Freeman from Obsession and Buddy the Unicorn are two of the most popular searches this year. Obsession released in May to rave reviews, skyrocketing actress Inde Navarrette to international stardom (later earning her the role of Rogue in Marvel’s upcoming X-Men reboot ). Discourse surrounding the film went viral, and Nikki Freeman even became a wandering character at Universal Studios’ Halloween Horror Nights . It’s little surprise, then, that Nikki is the third most-searched Halloween costume this year on Google, as told by the platform’s ‘Frightgeist’ page. Google Frightgeist is an interactive website that aggregates all the search trends surrounding spooky season, including horror movies, couples’ costumes, pet costumes, and general costumes that are trending the most. Obsession took two of the top spots in these categories; according to Frightgeist, Nikki is the third most-searched Halloween costume overall, with Buddy the Unicorn in first place and Needoh (a type of tactile squish toy) coming in second. Google says that “red zebra halter top” was searched more than ever before following Obsession’s release in May, a top that’s worn by the character in one of the movie’s pivotal scenes. Here’s the Top 10 list of trending Halloween costumes this year on Google: Buddy the Unicorn ( Buddy ) Needoh Nikki (Obsession) Agamemnon ( The Odyssey ) Lily Love Braids ( Poppy Playtime ) Oliver Tree Verity ( Minecraft ) Carl ( Dungeon Crawler Carl ) Disco Scooby Doo Hazel Hook (Descendants) Nikki and Bear were also the third top-trending couples’ costume on Google, beaten out by Disco Scooby and Shaggy in first place and the X-Men's Cyclops and Jean Gray in third place. (Alright, the internet might have good taste this year.) However, Obsession was nowhere to be found in Google’s Top 10 most-searched horror movies; instead, films like Buddy, Other Mommy, and Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil made the cut. The Top 10 searches are listed below: Buddy Other Mommy The Whisper Man Passenger Brute Insidious: Out of the Further Resident Evil Arachnaphobia Hokum The Backrooms It’s been an extremely good year for horror films, with small-budget productions and indie projects proving to be especially popular among moviegoers. In fact, Kane Parsons’ Backrooms enjoyed such success that it kicked off a major trend in the industry, with similar creepypasta projects like Siren Head , The Mandela Catalogue , and even The SCP Foundation getting greenlit for future film adaptations.

items.title: LEGO Venetian Neighborhood Set Is Coming in November
items.excerpt: LEGO has announced a gorgeous Venetian Neighborhood set that releases in November, but it's not cheap at $550.
items.content_text: LEGO has announced a new 5,682-piece set called LEGO Icons Venetian Neighborhood. It’s an intricate set depicting several Italian buildings situated on a canal, with a bridge connecting them. It’s a well populated Venice scene, as it includes 17 minifigures. The price fits the high piece count; it costs $549.99 and is scheduled to release November 1 for LEGO Insiders (you can sign up here for free) or November 4 for everyone else. You can view the listing here , but preorders are not available. LEGO Icons Venetian Neighborhood Price : $549.99 Pieces : 5,682 Set # : 11388 Ages : 18+ Release Date : Out November 1 for LEGO Insiders , and November 4 for everyone Dimensions : Over 19 in. (48 cm) high, 25 in. (64 cm) wide and 13 in. (33 cm) deep It’s a lovely set that includes, according to the official description, a “luxury villa, an artisan glassblowing workshop and astronomical clock tower.” The buildings are built in a modular way that lets you remove roofs and entire floors to see the detailed interiors. In addition, the set can be separated into two distinct sections to create alternate display layouts, keeping things fresh. Also included is a long gondola that fits neatly under the arched bridge. The 17 minifigures populating the neighborhood include gondoliers, musicians, tourists, and two carnival-goers dressed in costumes and masks. Also included is a 3D-printed street piano piece (you can see a close-up of it in the slideshow below). Buying the set at the LEGO Store will also get you the LEGO Icons Venetian Water Taxi set (40898) as a free Gift With Purchase. It’s a 322-piece set containing a water taxi and a dock setting, plus captain and tourist minifigures, as well as two pigeon figures. LEGO Venetian Neighborhood is the latest announcement in the LEGO Icons theme, which features somewhat intricate sets intended for adults or advanced builders. These sets are intended for display rather than play, and consist of things like impressive buildings, vehicles, and classic pop culture, well, icons. It’s a pretty loose theme as these things go, seeing as it fits everything from the massive LEGO Titanic set to a set based on Toothless from How to Train Your Dragon. You can see all the current LEGO Icons sets here . LEGO releases tend to peter out toward the end of the year, and that appears to be the case in 2026 as well. Including this one, only four sets have been announced for November, with a grand total of zero sets announced for December. However, we can expect a big new LEGO set to release on Black Friday, as is tradition. That set has yet to be announced. For more, check out our full list of upcoming LEGO sets , complete with release dates, set numbers, pricing, and links to preorder where available.

items.title: The Batman Part II Production Pause Is Not Permanent, DC Studios Confirms
items.excerpt: The show must go on. DC Studios co-CEO and co-chairman Peter Safran addressed the production stoppage on The Batman: Part II in a new interview with IGN.
items.content_text: The show must go on. DC Studios co-CEO and co-chairman Peter Safran addressed the production stoppage on The Batman: Part II in a new interview with IGN. Filming of The Batman: Part II had been underway in the UK until it was halted earlier this month so that director Matt Reeves could see to a "family matter." "Production on The Batman Part II has been temporarily paused while Matt Reeves focuses on a family matter,” Warner Bros. stated at the time. “Matt has the full support of DC Studios and we look forward to continuing the journey soon.” Here’s my exact exchange with Safran from our chat this past Monday. IGN: I want to be very delicate about how I ask this. Is there any scenario where Batman: Part II doesn't start filming again? Peter Safran: No. Whether that means filming will resume at some point under Reeves’ direction or if a replacement will take over the directing reins remains to be seen. Elsewhere in our full interview with him, Safran said of the film, “Batman: Part II, everybody's aware of the issues we're having right now, but, what we've seen so far of the shoot, it looked absolutely fantastic and Matt Reeves is a supremely talented filmmaker.” A sequel to Reeves’ 2022 film, The Batman: Part II is going in “another totally different direction” than its predecessor, according to star Robert Pattinson. Speculation about Part II’s plot and characters has been rampant online, with everyone from the Court of Owls to Mister Freeze and Two-Face rumored to factor into its story. Photos and videos from the Glasgow set were all over social media before production was temporarily shut down, including a closer look at Batman’s updated Arkham-style batsuit and a chase sequence between Batman and the Gotham City Police . The Batmobile itself appears in pretty bad shape after some barrel rolls in some of the set photos. It’s unclear right now if The Batman Part II’s release date will be pushed again . It’s currently scheduled to open in theaters on February 18, 2028.
items.title_en: The Batman Part II Production Pause Is Not Permanent, DC Studios Confirms

items.title: A Massive Decompilation Community Is Shutting Down, Thanks to the Deluge of AI Decomps and Ports
items.excerpt: If you've been on gaming Twitter at all over the last month, you're probably aware of a massive wave of people using AI to rapidly decompile, port and remix games. Well, that wave of AI decomps has forced a massive decompilation community to sunset.
items.content_text: If you've been on gaming Twitter at all over the last month, you're probably aware of the massive wave of people using AI to rapidly decompile, port, and remix games. That wave of AI decomps has forced a massive decompilation community to sunset. In a blog post, admin @encounter from decomp.dev , a community repository for people to track decompilation posts, cites a wave of bad actors who are using AI to essentially steal the hard work of programmers working on existing decompilation projects. The act of decompiling games itself isn't new, and people have been taking games and trying to decompile them down to the source code for years. But what was once a herculean task requiring coding expertise can now be done with little effort thanks to new AI models like GPT 6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. The blog post doesn't blame the models themselves for the surge of vibe-coded decompilations and ports, but rather claims that bad actors are taking existing projects and then using AI to rush them to completion. While there might be some developers who are open to people with a Claude subscription using their work to create, say, a browser port of Halo , that should be up to each developer. The post says, "Every project works differently: some may not want to use AI for legal or ethical reasons, and others may be okay with AI, or use AI themselves, but do not want drive-by contributions from folks who have put no effort into making sure the contributions are good. The bottom line is that these kinds of hostile forks put little to no effort into meaningfully contributing to existing projects, tearing apart our community fabric." As for the ports themselves, the blog claims that people are taking the code from hobbyists and forcing a barely functioning port out of them. "While community members put in the effort to decompile a game, opportunists have frequently raced to release a half-baked, barely-functional port from it," @encounter writes. The blog post also mentions that this recent wave of AI decomps, recomps, and ports is muddying the waters of what the decomp community is trying to do. A lot of classical decomps are done out of the love of games and a desire to know how they work, but this trend of using AI to brute force working PC ports has caused a lot of people to rush into communities like decomp.dev looking for simple ways to create easy PC ports of games. As for decomp.dev itself, the website will still exist, and users can use it to track existing projects, but @encounter is taking down the main index and disabling new projects. Unfortunately, when it comes to Opus 5.5, Astra 6, and decomps, the cat is out of the bag, and it's unlikely that one decomp repository going offline is going to meaningfully stop this trend. We've seen everything from making Minecraft playable on X/Twitter to modders shoving Minecraft and Elden Ring together . There have also been a lot of browser ports, with games like Halo: Combat Evolved and Grand Theft Auto 5 being briefly playable on Chrome before those games' respective publishers predictibly brought them crashing down. Either way, it's a shame to see a community built out of the love of programming essentially die off because a bunch of people with Claude subscriptions are using game developers' work as a starting point and finishing it with AI.
items.title_en: A Massive Decompilation Community Is Shutting Down, Thanks to the Deluge of AI Decomps and Ports

items.title: K/DA Is Getting an Official Louis Vuitton Art Book Ahead of 'Start a Fire' Comeback
items.content_text: Riot Games has teamed up with fashion house Louis Vuitton on a K/DA Travel Book. The book’s reveal comes just after the League of Legends girl group announced their return from a six-year hiatus. Tempo Point will collect new illustrations of the virtual girl group, envisioning “24 hours within the individual lives of K/DA members Ahri (vocalist), Akali (rapper), Evelynn (vocalist), and Kai’Sa (vocalist and lead dancer/choreographer).” A Standard edition and Collector’s edition will be released online and in select Louis Vuitton locations and bookstores on Friday, October 16. The Louis Vuitton Travel Books are a series of premium artbooks, compiling images and illustrations from artists around the world. This particular addition to the collection will be available in two formats: a Standard Edition ($68 USD) and a Collector’s Large-Format Edition ($245 USD). Both editions feature the same artwork in six-color printing, collected in a cloth-bound hardcover book with a silk-screened cover. Only 400 copies are being printed of the Collector's Edition, which will be available for purchase online on Louis Vuitton’s website , at Louis Vuitton stores, and in select bookstores. The Standard Edition will be available from the same places, and will also be shown off at the upcoming League of Legends Worlds 2026 Fan Fest event scheduled for November 12 to 14 in New York. Select Louis Vuitton stores will also have limited-edition signed copies that come with an exclusive vinyl record. Only 30 total copies of this edition will be available. While the Louis Vuitton of it all may seem a bit random, the French fashion house has actually been a consistent collaborator for Riot Games and the virtual girl group. In 2019, the House served as the official Summoner’s Cup Trophy Trunk provider for the League Worlds Championship. Nicolas Ghesquière, the House’s Artistic Director of Women's Collections, has designed a number of skins for League of Legends, and the House dressed K/DA and guest artist Lexie Liu, who voiced Seraphine, throughout promotions for “MORE.” K/DA, a virtual pop group which debuted with the single POP/STARS in 2018, just teased their first comeback since 2020. The new project was revealed with an image posted to K/DA social accounts , showing each members’ eyes and the tagline “Start a Fire.” The full project will be revealed on October 20. Fortiche has been interacting with the official K/DA announcement on various social platforms, suggesting the Arcane studio may have animated a new K/DA music video.
items.title_en: K/DA Is Getting an Official Louis Vuitton Art Book Ahead of 'Start a Fire' Comeback
